fix.why: For Claude Code or Codex, run `gbrain setup claude-code` or `gbrain setup codex` (it registers serve behind gbrain's launcher, so the session directory's bunfig.toml and .env never load). For any other host, register `<absolute path to gbrain> serve --surface starter --advertise verbs` as a stdio MCP server in your agent host; the install section lists the exact command per harness (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, opencode, OpenClaw).

notices.user_message: gbrain is installed. In effect: search mode conservative; agents save only what you ask them to remember, until you turn on automatic saving (gbrain recommends salient: durable facts you state, saved with provenance). Upkeep: free upkeep runs on its own while your agent's gbrain session is open. Nothing is deleted or paid for without you. Turn off: gbrain config set maintenance.auto false. Optional schedule: gbrain maintain --schedule. Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload at 10K queries/month (Haiku 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Opus 5.5): conservative $4 / $80 / $160, balanced $10 / $200 / $400, tokenmax $20 / $400 / $800 per month. Nothing needs an answer now; tell me any time if you want to change any of these, and I'll apply it.
